sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Saturday August 10, 1963 was a stormy winter's night in Perth, with heavy rain and thunder.
sentences.zh: 1963年8月10日，星期六，那是一个暴风雨之夜，珀斯雷雨交加。

sentences.en: But Carl and Wendy Dowd were heading out anyway, to go to a party just a kilometre from their home in Dalkeith.
sentences.zh: 但卡尔·多德和温迪·多德夫妇还是决定出门，去参加一个离他们在达尔基斯的家仅一公里远的派对。

sentences.en: The suburb was just south of Netherlands, which had been upended by the Australia Day shootings six months earlier.
sentences.zh: 这个郊区位于尼德兰以南，而尼德兰在六个月前的澳大利亚日枪击案中刚刚经历了一场动荡。

sentences.en: The initial panic after that event had somewhat calmed down by now.
sentences.zh: 那起事件引发的最初恐慌，到此时已经平息了一些。

sentences.en: Even though the shooter hadn't been apprehended, the fact that there hadn't been any shootings since meant that locals had started to relax ever so slightly.
sentences.zh: 尽管枪手尚未落网，但自那以后再未发生过枪击事件，这意味着当地居民的心态已稍稍放松。

sentences.en: Carl and Wendy had hired a second-year university student to babysit their eight-month-old while they were out.
sentences.zh: 卡尔和温迪雇了一名大二学生，在他们外出时照看八个月大的孩子。

sentences.en: Shirley MacLeod was a diligent science major who was filling in for her friend, the Dowd's usual sitter.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·麦克劳德是一位勤奋的理科生，她是替朋友来帮忙的，而那位朋友才是多德夫妇平时的保姆。

sentences.en: She had won a scholarship to attend university and her plan was to become a social worker.
sentences.zh: 她曾获得奖学金进入大学，并计划将来成为一名社会工作者。

sentences.en: There are so many people who need help, she had once told her father.
sentences.zh: “有太多人需要帮助了，”她曾这样对父亲说。

sentences.en: Shirley had been devastated by the murder of her friend John Sturkey in the Australia Day shootings.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的好友约翰·斯特基在澳大利亚日枪击案中遇害，这让她悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: They had shared some of the same uni lectures.
sentences.zh: 他们曾一起上过几门大学课程。

sentences.en: Carl and Wendy felt confident leaving their baby in Shirley's care.
sentences.zh: 卡尔和温迪很放心地把孩子交给雪莉照顾。

sentences.en: She was a kind, conscientious girl who'd brought her textbooks with her.
sentences.zh: 她是个善良、尽责的女孩，还随身带着课本。

sentences.en: As the baby was sleeping, Shirley was hoping to get some study done.
sentences.zh: 趁孩子睡觉时，雪莉希望能复习一下功课。

sentences.en: The Dowds said goodbye, then headed out to their party.
sentences.zh: 多德夫妇道别后，便动身前往派对。

sentences.en: It was 2am when they arrived home, happy and in high spirits, after a fun night out.
sentences.zh: 凌晨两点，他们回到家时，依然兴致高昂，显然度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

sentences.en: Wendy went straight to the bedroom to check on the baby, while Carl headed to the lounge room where Shirley had been sitting when they left.
sentences.zh: 温迪径直走进卧室查看孩子，而卡尔则走向客厅，那是他们离开时雪莉坐的地方。

sentences.en: The lounge was well lit and warm, as Shirley had the heater running.
sentences.zh: 客厅里灯火通明，十分温暖，因为雪莉开了暖气。

sentences.en: A teacup and saucer sat on the coffee table, and the turntable was spinning with a record that had long since finished playing.
sentences.zh: 茶几上放着一个茶杯和托盘，唱片机还在转动，但唱片早已播放完毕。

sentences.en: Shirley's shoes sat neatly on the floor, while she sat on a small couch, her head slumped.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的鞋子整齐地放在地板上，她坐在小沙发上，头耷拉着。

sentences.en: Carl assumed she must have dozed off while studying, as she was still holding a pen and notepad.
sentences.zh: 卡尔以为她一定是学习时睡着了，因为她手里还拿着笔和记事本。

sentences.en: Then, Carl noticed that Shirley's clothes and face were covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 随后，卡尔注意到雪莉的衣服和脸上满是鲜血。

sentences.en: Clearly visible in her forehead was a bullet hole.
sentences.zh: 她的额头上有一个清晰可见的弹孔。

sentences.en: She had been shot and killed with a .22 caliber rifle.
sentences.zh: 她被人用.22口径步枪射杀身亡。

sentences.en: As Carl Dowd was struck by the shocking realisation that Shirley MacLeod had been murdered, he was gripped by the terrifying fear that the killer might still be in the house.
sentences.zh: 当卡尔·多德意识到雪莉·麦克劳德被谋杀这一残酷事实时，他陷入了极度的恐惧，担心凶手可能还在屋内。

sentences.en: He raced to the bedroom where Wendy was tending to their 8-month-old son.
sentences.zh: 他冲进卧室，温迪正在那里照顾他们8个月大的儿子。

sentences.en: He was awake and smiling, clearly unharmed.
sentences.zh: 孩子醒着，正微笑着，显然安然无恙。

sentences.en: Carl told Wendy what had happened before quietly phoning the police.
sentences.zh: 卡尔告诉了温迪发生的事情，然后悄悄报了警。

sentences.en: The Dowd family remained barricaded in the bedroom until help arrived.
sentences.zh: 多德一家在卧室里反锁房门，等待救援到来。

sentences.en: While the case couldn't be definitively linked to the killing spree in late January, investigating officers had their suspicions.
sentences.zh: 虽然这起案件无法明确与一月下旬的连环杀人案联系起来，但调查人员对此心存怀疑。

sentences.en: The victims in all of the murders were random and had been targeted in homes.
sentences.zh: 所有谋杀案的受害者都是随机选择的，且都是在自家中遇害。

sentences.en: All had been killed with a single shot to the forehead from a .22 caliber weapon.
sentences.zh: 所有人都是被.22口径武器近距离射击额头致死。

sentences.en: Perth was still scarred by the Australia Day massacre and the sudden re-emergence of the shooter sent the city into a new wave of panic.
sentences.zh: 珀斯仍笼罩在澳大利亚日大屠杀的阴影中，枪手的突然重现让整座城市陷入了新一轮的恐慌。

sentences.en: The killer was dubbed the Netherlands Monster.
sentences.zh: 凶手被称为“尼德兰怪物”。

sentences.en: Young women stopped taking on jobs and people opted to stay at home with their families rather than go out at night.
sentences.zh: 年轻女性不再接保姆工作，人们宁愿待在家里陪家人，也不愿在晚上出门。

sentences.en: Shirley's murder became the police department's top priority.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的谋杀案成为了警方的首要任务。

sentences.en: Almost none of the Dowd's neighbours had heard anything suspicious that night, though one man said he'd heard a particularly loud clap of thunder that could have been a gunshot.
sentences.zh: 当晚，多德夫妇的邻居几乎没人听到任何可疑动静，不过有一名男子说他听到了特别响的一声雷鸣，那可能是一声枪响。

sentences.en: The timing of it had aligned with Shirley's suspected time of death.
sentences.zh: 那声音出现的时间与推测的雪莉死亡时间相吻合。

sentences.en: A squad of 50 detectives door-knocked homes throughout Dowdkeith and Netherlands, interviewing more than 8,000 residents.
sentences.zh: 一支由50名侦探组成的队伍对道德基斯和尼德兰的住户进行了逐门走访，采访了超过8000名居民。

sentences.en: Police recovered a single, unidentified fingerprint from the home, which didn't match anyone who was known to have visited or lived there.
sentences.zh: 警方在屋内提取到一枚身份不明的指纹，该指纹与任何已知到访或居住在那里的人都不匹配。

sentences.en: It was decided that police would take the fingerprints of all males aged between 14 and 60 in the Perth metropolitan area, starting with the Netherlands and Cotterslow.
sentences.zh: 警方决定对珀斯大都会区所有14至60岁的男性进行指纹采集，首先从尼德兰和科特斯洛开始。

sentences.en: Police had also extracted the bullet from Shirley MacLeod's head, which had distinct markings they could use to identify the murder weapon if it was ever found.
sentences.zh: 警方还从雪莉·麦克劳德的头部取出了弹头，上面有独特的痕迹，如果能找到凶器，就可以用来进行比对。

sentences.en: William and Cecilia Keener were an elderly couple who resided in the South Perth suburb of Mount Pleasant.
sentences.zh: 威廉·基纳和塞西莉亚·基纳是一对住在珀斯南部芒特普莱森特郊区的老夫妇。

sentences.en: Their daily habit of taking a walk together every afternoon had recently been disrupted by the heavy rain Perth was experiencing, but on Friday August 16, the sun was shining.
sentences.zh: 他们每天下午一起散步的习惯最近因珀斯的大雨而中断，但8月16日星期五那天，阳光明媚。

sentences.en: The pair set off sometime after 3pm.
sentences.zh: 两人在下午3点过后不久出发了。

sentences.en: They liked to stroll down the road where they lived, which was called Hawken Street, to the banks of the Swan River.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢沿着居住的霍肯街漫步，一直走到天鹅河岸边。

sentences.en: The couple kept a little fishing boat down there, which they would check on, and they'd also stop to chat to neighbours they met along the way.
sentences.zh: 夫妇俩在那里有一艘小渔船，他们会去检查一下，沿途还会停下来和遇到的邻居聊天。

sentences.en: On this particular Friday, they turned left upon reaching the river and walked up towards Canning Bridge.
sentences.zh: 在这个特定的周五，他们到达河边后向左转，朝着坎宁大桥走去。

sentences.en: As they ambled along, they noticed that one of the trees along the path had several limbs snapped off.
sentences.zh: 当他们漫步时，注意到路边的一棵树上有几根树枝断了。

sentences.en: Car tracks were visible in the ground leading towards it.
sentences.zh: 地面上有明显的车轮痕迹延伸到那里。

sentences.en: The couple wondered if there had been an accident and whether the driver had been hurt.
sentences.zh: 夫妇俩纳闷是否发生过事故，司机是否受了伤。

sentences.en: After walking about 500 metres along the riverbank,
sentences.zh: 沿着河岸走了大约500米后，

sentences.en: William and Cecilia turned left at Rookwood Street to make a loop home.
sentences.zh: 威廉和塞西莉亚在鲁克伍德街左转，准备绕路回家。

sentences.en: Pale pink native wildflowers were growing in abundance all along the street, and Cecilia decided to pick some.
sentences.zh: 街边长满了淡粉色的原生野花，塞西莉亚决定采摘一些。

sentences.en: As she reached up to take a sprig, something on the ground slipped and brushed Cecilia's knee.
sentences.zh: 当她伸手去摘一枝花时，地上的某个东西滑了一下，擦到了塞西莉亚的膝盖。

sentences.en: It was the butt of a rifle.
sentences.zh: 那是一把步枪的枪托。

sentences.en: Shocked, Cecilia pushed the firearm back under the bush before telling William, there's a rifle here.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚大吃一惊，把枪推回灌木丛下，然后告诉威廉：“这儿有把步枪。”

sentences.en: After taking a look for himself,
sentences.zh: 威廉亲自查看后，

sentences.en: William suggested they take it home to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands.
sentences.zh: 建议把枪带回家，以免落入坏人之手。

sentences.en: As neither of them held gun licences,
sentences.zh: 由于他们两人都没有持枪证，

sentences.en: Cecilia opposed this plan.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚反对这个计划。

sentences.en: Instead, when they got home, she reported the discovery to the police.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们回到家后，她向警方报告了这一发现。

sentences.en: It was a 22-gauge Winchester rifle, different from the Lithgow single-shot rifle used in the Australia Day shootings.
sentences.zh: 那是一把.22口径的温彻斯特步枪，与澳大利亚日枪击案中使用的利斯戈单发步枪不同。

sentences.en: Still, it was worth investigating.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，它仍值得调查。

sentences.en: Officers searched the entirety of Rookwood Street but didn't find a single cartridge.
sentences.zh: 警官们搜查了整条鲁克伍德街，但没有找到一颗弹壳。

sentences.en: However, the rifle was still loaded with a single bullet.
sentences.zh: 不过，步枪里还装有一发子弹。

sentences.en: When police test-fired the weapon, they found that the copper-nosed bullet had the same markings as the one taken from Shirley MacLeod's body.
sentences.zh: 当警方对武器进行试射时，发现铜头子弹留下的痕迹与从雪莉·麦克劳德体内取出的弹头痕迹相同。

sentences.en: They had found the weapon used by her killer.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了凶手使用的武器。

sentences.en: It turned out that the rifle was registered to a former Olympic swimmer named Garrick Agnew.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这把步枪登记在一位名叫加里克·阿格纽的前奥运游泳选手名下。

sentences.en: Garrick had spent the last month and a half overseas.
sentences.zh: 加里克过去一个半月都在海外。

sentences.en: When he'd returned home just a few days earlier, he'd discovered that his Winchester rifle was missing from the bedroom cupboard where he kept it.
sentences.zh: 几天前他刚回到家，就发现他的温彻斯特步枪从存放它的卧室壁橱里不见了。

sentences.en: Nothing else had been taken from the home, including a second rifle that was stored in another room.
sentences.zh: 家中没有丢失其他东西，包括存放在另一个房间的第二把步枪。

sentences.en: Garrick had reported the rifle stolen on Tuesday August 13.
sentences.zh: 加里克在8月13日星期二报了警，称步枪被盗。

sentences.en: Police were interested in the way that the rifle had been left in the bush on Rookwood Street.
sentences.zh: 警方对步枪被遗弃在鲁克伍德街灌木丛中的方式很感兴趣。

sentences.en: It hadn't been carelessly discarded somewhere, as though the killer was tossing it aside permanently.
sentences.zh: 它并没有被随意丢弃在某处，看起来不像凶手彻底抛弃了它。

sentences.en: Instead, it had been hidden inside thick vegetation, something that someone might do if they planned to retrieve it at a later date.
sentences.zh: 相反，它被藏在茂密的植被中，这通常是有人计划日后取回时才会做的事。

sentences.en: Investigators took another rifle back to the bush where Cecilia Keener had found it and tied it there tightly with fishing line.
sentences.zh: 调查人员带着另一把步枪回到塞西莉亚·基纳发现它的灌木丛处，并用鱼线将其紧紧系在那里。

sentences.en: Police requested permission from the residents of the house opposite to set up a 24-hour-a-day lookout in their backyard, which spanned an entire block.
sentences.zh: 警方请求对面房子的居民允许他们在后院设立一个24小时监视点，该后院覆盖了整个街区。

sentences.en: That way, the bush with the rifle could be kept under constant surveillance.
sentences.zh: 这样，藏有步枪的灌木丛就能处于持续监控之下。

sentences.en: The residents gave their permission and agreed not to tell anyone about the top-secret operation.
sentences.zh: 居民们表示同意，并承诺不会向任何人透露这项绝密行动。

sentences.en: A trap to catch the killer was set.
sentences.zh: 一个诱捕凶手的陷阱设好了。

sentences.en: Now, all the police had to do was wait.
sentences.zh: 现在，警方要做的就是等待。

sentences.en: Over the next two weeks, police kept a 24-hour-a-day surveillance running in the property opposite the rifle, with at least one officer remaining on the lookout at all times.
sentences.zh: 接下来的两周里，警方在步枪对面的房产内保持24小时监视，始终至少有一名警官在值守。

sentences.en: It was a particularly cold and wet winter, which made their job even more difficult.
sentences.zh: 那是一个特别寒冷潮湿的冬天，这让他们的工作变得更加困难。

sentences.en: After a fortnight passed with no sign of the shooter, investigators decided they needed to do something to lure him back to his weapon.
sentences.zh: 两周过去了，仍不见枪手的踪影，调查人员决定采取行动，引诱他回来取回武器。

sentences.en: With the cooperation of local reporters, an article had been planted in multiple newspapers that stated police working the Shirley MacLeod case
sentences.zh: 在当地记者的配合下，多家报纸刊登了一篇报道，称负责雪莉·麦克劳德案的警方

sentences.en: would turn their attention to the suburb of Mount Pleasant by the end of the coming week.
sentences.zh: 将在下周结束前将调查重点转向芒特普莱森特郊区。

sentences.en: On the morning of Saturday August 31, one of Perth's papers ran a story about how police would be fingerprinting Mount Pleasant residents very soon.
sentences.zh: 8月31日星期六早上，珀斯的一份报纸刊登了一篇关于警方很快将对芒特普莱森特居民进行指纹采集的报道。

sentences.en: That night, Constable Bill Hawker was on surveillance duty in Rookwood Street.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，比尔·霍克警官在鲁克伍德街执行监视任务。

sentences.en: It was cool and slightly overcast, a pleasant change from the near-constant rain of the past two weeks, and Bill wondered if the killer would finally be spooked enough
sentences.zh: 天气凉爽，略有阴云，与过去两周几乎不停的雨相比，这令人感到舒适。比尔想知道凶手是否终于会被吓到，

sentences.en: to try retrieving his rifle.
sentences.zh: 从而试图取回他的步枪。

sentences.en: He took up his post at 6pm alongside a colleague named Peter Skihan.
sentences.zh: 他于下午6点与同事彼得·斯基汉一起上岗。

sentences.en: Several hours later, Constable Hawker was keeping watch alone while Constable Skihan rested inside a tent set up for the officers in the backyard across from the trap.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，霍克警官独自守候，而斯基汉警官则在陷阱对面后院为警官们搭建的帐篷里休息。

sentences.en: Constable Hawker could hear music from a nearby pub, and occasionally couples would stroll along Rookwood Street on their way home from a night out.
sentences.zh: 霍克警官能听到附近酒吧传来的音乐，偶尔有情侣从夜归途中沿着鲁克伍德街漫步经过。

sentences.en: But so far, no one had taken any interest in the trap.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，还没有人对那个陷阱表现出兴趣。

sentences.en: At 1.15 every night, the streetlights on Rookwood Street went out.
sentences.zh: 每天凌晨1点15分，鲁克伍德街的路灯会熄灭。

sentences.en: If the killer decided to return for his rifle, he would most likely do so after that time when the street was at its darkeSt.
sentences.zh: 如果凶手决定回来取枪，他很可能会在那之后，即街道最黑暗的时候行动。

sentences.en: When the lights switched off like clockwork,
sentences.zh: 当路灯像钟表一样准时熄灭时，

sentences.en: Constable Hawker braced himself and stared even more intently at the dark street in front of him.
sentences.zh: 霍克警官打起精神，更加专注地盯着前方黑暗的街道。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a grey-blue Holden sedan appeared and slowly pulled up at the curb opposite the trap.
sentences.zh: 突然，一辆蓝灰色的霍顿轿车出现，缓缓停在陷阱对面的路边。

sentences.en: The road was steep, so Constable Hawker could only see the top of the car.
sentences.zh: 道路很陡，所以霍克警官只能看到车顶。

sentences.en: His initial response was to wonder if it was a couple looking for a quiet spot to spend time together.
sentences.zh: 他最初的反应是怀疑那是否是一对寻找安静地方独处的情侣。

sentences.en: But then, the driver's side door partly opened, with the person behind the wheel holding it ajar.
sentences.zh: 但随后，驾驶座的车门半开着，开车的人把门虚掩着。

sentences.en: Several moments passed, then the door opened more widely.
sentences.zh: 过了片刻，车门开得更大了。

sentences.en: A man got out and stood still in the car's doorway.
sentences.zh: 一名男子下车，静静地站在车门旁。

sentences.en: Almost certain that he was looking at their suspect,
sentences.zh: 几乎可以肯定他看到的就是嫌疑人，

sentences.en: Constable Hawker rushed to the tent to wake his colleague.
sentences.zh: 霍克警官冲向帐篷叫醒了他的同事。

sentences.en: They had to act quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们必须迅速行动。

sentences.en: The rifle was tied to the bush and the killer would surely flee if he went to retrieve it and discovered the trap.
sentences.zh: 步枪被系在灌木丛上，如果凶手去取枪时发现陷阱，肯定会逃跑。

sentences.en: Nor did they want the killer to be armed by the time they were able to reach him.
sentences.zh: 他们也不希望凶手在他们赶到时已经武装起来。

sentences.en: Constable Hawker leapt over the property's fence, closely followed by Constable Skihan.
sentences.zh: 霍克警官跳过围栏，斯基汉警官紧随其后。

sentences.en: Crouching down in front of the bush was a man wearing a heavy overcoat.
sentences.zh: 灌木丛前蹲着一个穿着厚外套的男人。

sentences.en: As he heard the sound of the police officer's footsteps running towards him, he turned around to face them.
sentences.zh: 听到警官跑向他的脚步声，他转过身面对他们。

sentences.en: The two police officers grabbed the man in the overcoat, who struggled against them.
sentences.zh: 两名警官抓住了那个穿外套的男人，他奋力挣扎。

sentences.en: Constable Hawker pulled out a set of handcuffs and cuffed the man's wrists, then used a second set of cuffs to secure the man to a fence.
sentences.zh: 霍克警官掏出一副手铐铐住男人的手腕，然后用第二副手铐将他固定在围栏上。

sentences.en: The suspect mumbled incomprehensibly in a muffled voice as he was arrested.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人在被捕时发出含糊不清的嘟囔声。

sentences.en: In clearer light, the officers could see that he carried a small pencil torch and was wearing a pair of women's leather gloves.
sentences.zh: 在更亮的光线下，警官们看到他带着一支小型铅笔手电筒，戴着一副女式皮手套。

sentences.en: He had short dark hair, a broad nose, and a notable scar on his mouth from surgery to repair a cleft lip palate.
sentences.zh: 他留着深色短发，鼻子宽大，嘴部有一个明显的伤疤，那是修复唇腭裂手术留下的。

sentences.en: A search revealed that he was carrying a pair of women's underpants in one of his pockets and a newspaper clipping in another.
sentences.zh: 搜查发现，他的一个口袋里装着一条女式内裤，另一个口袋里有一张剪报。

sentences.en: He had scribbled some addresses and phone numbers on the clipping.
sentences.zh: 他在剪报上潦草地写了一些地址和电话号码。

sentences.en: Constables Hawker and Skihan called for backup and the suspect was transferred to police headquarters for questioning.
sentences.zh: 霍克和斯基汉警官呼叫了增援，嫌疑人被移交给警察总部进行审讯。

sentences.en: He was quickly identified as 32-year-old Eric Edgar Cook, a man who was already very well known to Western Australia police.
sentences.zh: 他很快被确认为32岁的埃里克·埃德加·库克，一个西澳大利亚警方非常熟悉的人。

sentences.en: On Friday, October 15, 1948,
sentences.zh: 1948年10月15日星期五，

sentences.en: Cook had committed his first break-in at the age of 17.
sentences.zh: 库克在17岁时犯下了他的第一次入室盗窃案。

sentences.en: He forced his way into a flat in Perth's CBD while its resident was out and stole a torch and a small clock.
sentences.zh: 他强行闯入珀斯市中心的一间公寓，趁住户外出时偷走了一支手电筒和一个小钟。

sentences.en: He also opened several bottles of wine and poured them all over the resident's clothing.
sentences.zh: 他还打开了几瓶葡萄酒，把酒倒在住户的衣服上。

sentences.en: When police later attended the crime scene, they found Cook's fingerprints all over the empty bottles.
sentences.zh: 当警方后来赶到犯罪现场时，发现空瓶子上到处都是库克的指纹。

sentences.en: Though they didn't match anyone in the system, they added the prints to their files.
sentences.zh: 虽然它们与系统中的任何人都不匹配，但警方还是将这些指纹存入了档案。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, Cook broke into another home.
sentences.zh: 几周后，库克闯入了另一户人家。

sentences.en: Angry after he found nothing he wanted to steal, he trashed the property by pulling all of the clothing from the wardrobes and cutting it with a knife.
sentences.zh: 因为没找到想偷的东西，他恼羞成怒，把衣柜里的衣服全部拉出来，用刀割烂，以此破坏财物。

sentences.en: He also slashed some bedding and a pillow before taking chocolate from the fridge and feeding it to the couple's pet goldfish.
sentences.zh: 他还割破了一些床上用品和一个枕头，然后从冰箱里拿出巧克力喂给这对夫妇的宠物金鱼吃。

sentences.en: His final act was to start a fire in the living room.
sentences.zh: 他最后的举动是在客厅里放火。

sentences.en: The resident returned to find his flat in flames and although firefighters were able to save the home, the damage cost almost $20,000 in today's money.
sentences.zh: 住户回来时发现公寓已陷入火海，尽管消防员成功保住了房子，但损失折合今天的货币价值近2万美元。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, Cook broke into another home and stole 20 shillings.
sentences.zh: 两周后，库克闯入另一户人家，偷走了20先令。

sentences.en: He had an engagement ring, a watch, and a fountain pen.
sentences.zh: 他当时有一枚订婚戒指、一块手表和一支钢笔。

sentences.en: He later tossed the jury out of fear of being caught.
sentences.zh: 后来他因为害怕被抓而把赃物扔掉了。

sentences.en: Not long after that, at Christmas time,
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，圣诞节期间，

sentences.en: Cook was asked by a friend to house-sit for her while she and her husband were away.
sentences.zh: 一位朋友请库克在她和丈夫外出时帮忙看家。

sentences.en: Despite having a key to the property,
sentences.zh: 尽管有房子的钥匙，

sentences.en: Cook smashed a window to cover his tracks and decided to set fire to the residence.
sentences.zh: 库克还是砸碎了一扇窗户来掩盖行踪，并决定放火烧毁住所。

sentences.en: He piled all of his friend's clothing on the bedroom floor then coated it in fly spray as an accelerant.
sentences.zh: 他把朋友所有的衣服堆在卧室地板上，然后喷上杀虫剂作为助燃剂。

sentences.en: Yet, his plan ultimately failed when he couldn't find any matches.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的计划最终失败了，因为他找不到火柴。

sentences.en: A week later, on New Year's Eve,
sentences.zh: 一周后，在新年前夜，

sentences.en: Cook celebrated the beginning of 1949 by breaking into an empty flat in the CBD.
sentences.zh: 库克以闯入中央商务区一间空公寓的方式庆祝了1949年的开始。

sentences.en: He used some cellophane and a candle that he found inside to light a fire.
sentences.zh: 他利用在里面找到的玻璃纸和一支蜡烛点燃了一把火。

sentences.en: When the resident came home at 12.35am, she found her bedroom completely destroyed by the blaze.
sentences.zh: 当住户在凌晨12点35分回家时，她发现自己的卧室已被大火彻底烧毁。

sentences.en: Cook continued to commit more break-ins across the city during the first months of 1949, leaving fingerprints behind when he stole whatever cash he found
sentences.zh: 1949年的头几个月里，库克在城里继续犯下多起入室盗窃案，他在偷走发现的所有现金时留下了指纹，

sentences.en: along with women's underwear.
sentences.zh: 同时还偷走了女性内衣。

sentences.en: He also lit more fires at other addresses.
sentences.zh: 他还在其他地址放了更多的火。

sentences.en: Once, he defecated in a toy cot that belonged to a child.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他在一个属于孩子的玩具婴儿床上排便。

sentences.en: In early March, Cook broke into a house just north of the CBD, entering via the back door.
sentences.zh: 3月初，库克从后门闯入了一栋位于中央商务区北部的房子。

sentences.en: Cook knew the property, as he'd delivered groceries there previously while working for a market.
sentences.zh: 库克对这处房产很熟悉，因为他之前在市场工作时曾送货到那里。

sentences.en: It was late at night and the residents were in their beds asleep.
sentences.zh: 当时已是深夜，住户们都在床上熟睡。

sentences.en: The now 18-year-old Cook was more emboldened and no longer just targeted empty homes.
sentences.zh: 此时已18岁的库克胆子更大了，不再仅仅针对空房下手。

sentences.en: Using a torch to see,
sentences.zh: 他用手电筒照明，

sentences.en: Cook found a purse and took it to the bathroom to search through.
sentences.zh: 库克发现了一个钱包，并把它带到浴室里翻找。

sentences.en: As he was rummaging through the purse, a man entered the bathroom and found him.
sentences.zh: 当他正在翻钱包时，一名男子走进浴室发现了他在里面。

sentences.en: It was one of the residents who'd been woken by his wife after she heard Cook creeping about.
sentences.zh: 那是住户之一，他在妻子听到库克潜入的声音并将他叫醒后起床查看。

sentences.en: Cook claimed to be a neighbour who had drunkenly entered the property by mistake and gave his first name.
sentences.zh: 库克谎称自己是邻居，醉酒后误入了这处房产，并报出了自己的名字。

sentences.en: His lies weren't believed.
sentences.zh: 他的谎言并没有被相信。

sentences.en: When the resident tried to grapple with him,
sentences.zh: 当住户试图与他扭打时，

sentences.en: Cook fled.
sentences.zh: 库克逃跑了。

sentences.en: Police tracked him down a week later and matched his fingerprints to two previous break-ins.
sentences.zh: 警方在一周后追踪到了他，并将他的指纹与之前的两起入室盗窃案进行了比对。

sentences.en: He was charged and taken before the courts.
sentences.zh: 他被控告并被带上法庭。

sentences.en: Cook was convicted on two counts of stealing, four counts of arson and seven of breaking and entering.
sentences.zh: 库克因两项盗窃罪、四项纵火罪和七项非法闯入罪被定罪。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to three years in prison with the recommendation he'd be released on parole after a few months so that he could be rehabilitated.
sentences.zh: 他被判处三年监禁，并建议他在几个月后获得假释，以便他能改过自新。

sentences.en: Cook's father was an abusive alcoholic who terrorised his entire family but focused most of his rage on his son.
sentences.zh: 库克的父亲是一个虐待成性的酒鬼，他恐吓全家，但将大部分愤怒集中在儿子身上。

sentences.en: Cook had been born with a cleft palate and lip, a common birth defect that made his father hate him.
sentences.zh: 库克天生患有唇腭裂，这是一种常见的出生缺陷，这让他的父亲厌恶他。

sentences.en: He beat his son and verbally abused him.
sentences.zh: 他殴打儿子并对他进行言语辱骂。

sentences.en: Once, when Cook had tried to stop his father from beating up his mother, his father punched him so badly he suffered a skull fracture.
sentences.zh: 有一次，当库克试图阻止父亲殴打母亲时，父亲猛击他，导致他颅骨骨折。

sentences.en: Students at school had also bullied and ostracised Cook, mocking his appearance and a distinctive speech impediment that was the result of his birth defect.
sentences.zh: 学校里的学生也欺负和排挤库克，嘲笑他的外貌以及因出生缺陷导致的独特语言障碍。

sentences.en: One time, Cook's mother saw her son standing in front of a mirror, violently pulling at his scarred lip.
sentences.zh: 有一次，库克的母亲看到儿子站在镜子前，用力拉扯着他那道伤疤明显的嘴唇。

sentences.en: Desperate for an escape,
sentences.zh: 为了寻求逃离，

sentences.en: Cook had started wandering the streets of Perth and stealing from his teachers, neighbours and peers as a child.
sentences.zh: 库克从小就开始在珀斯的街头游荡，并偷窃老师、邻居和同龄人的东西。

sentences.en: There were concerns that hard time would only serve to further criminalise the first-time offender.
sentences.zh: 有人担心，严厉的监禁只会让这个初犯者进一步走向犯罪。

sentences.en: The parole board ultimately decided to release Eric Attica Cook in August 1949, agreeing that his brief stint in prison had been enough to scare him straight.
sentences.zh: 假释委员会最终决定在1949年8月释放埃里克·阿提卡·库克，认为他短暂的牢狱之灾足以让他改邪归正。

sentences.en: They felt that Cook had committed crimes because he was socially isolated and saw the acts as a way to gain notoriety and friendships.
sentences.zh: 他们认为库克犯罪是因为他在社交上被孤立，并将这些行为视为获得名声和友谊的一种方式。

sentences.en: Although he had been an intelligent student, his education was hindered by his behavioural problems and his father, who forced him to leave school at the age of 14.
sentences.zh: 尽管他曾是一名聪明的学生，但他的学业因行为问题和父亲的阻挠而受阻，父亲强迫他在14岁时辍学。

sentences.en: Cook started working from then on, passing most of his earnings on to his mother and a stealing to supplement his own income.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，库克开始工作，将大部分收入交给母亲，并靠偷窃来补贴自己的开销。

sentences.en: From then on,
sentences.zh: 从那时起，

sentences.en: Cook worked a series of menial jobs.
sentences.zh: 库克做了一系列卑微的工作。

sentences.en: He was an accident-prone person and his employment record was impacted by repeated accidents.
sentences.zh: 他是一个容易发生意外的人，他的就业记录也受到反复事故的影响。

sentences.en: Once, his face was badly scalded by steam.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他的脸被蒸汽严重烫伤。

sentences.en: Another time, he fell and damaged his spine, leading to a week in hospital.
sentences.zh: 另一次，他摔倒伤及脊椎，导致住院一周。

sentences.en: Cook's many injuries included multiple head injuries.
sentences.zh: 库克受过多次伤，包括多次头部受伤。

sentences.en: He would often slip and hit his head, resulting in concussions and further fractures.
sentences.zh: 他经常滑倒并撞到头，导致脑震荡和进一步的骨折。

sentences.en: Following his release from prison, he started working at a confectionery company and joined a church.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，他开始在一家糖果公司工作并加入了教会。

sentences.en: Overall, his life improved.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，他的生活有所改善。

sentences.en: His probation period concluded two years later on August 15, 1951.
sentences.zh: 他的缓刑期在两年后的1951年8月15日结束。

sentences.en: To celebrate his return to freedom,
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝重获自由，

sentences.en: Cook travelled east across the country to Melbourne, where he enlisted in the Australian Army.
sentences.zh: 库克向东横跨全国前往墨尔本，在那里他加入了澳大利亚军队。

sentences.en: During his training, he became an excellent marksman, but was discharged three months later when the army learnt of his previous offending.
sentences.zh: 在训练期间，他成为了一名出色的神枪手，但在军队得知他之前的犯罪记录后，三个月后他被开除。

sentences.en: Cook returned to Perth and started working as a truck driver.
sentences.zh: 库克回到珀斯，开始做卡车司机。

sentences.en: The short, dark-haired man had never had much luck with women, but in 1953, he met a young woman named Sally Lavin.
sentences.zh: 这个身材矮小、深色头发的男人在女人缘方面一直不太好，但在1953年，他遇到了一个名叫萨莉·拉文的年轻女子。

sentences.en: They married in November of that year and settled in the inner eastern suburb of Rivervale.
sentences.zh: 他们于同年11月结婚，并在内东郊的里弗维尔定居。

sentences.en: Less than two years later, the couple already had two sons.
sentences.zh: 不到两年，这对夫妇就已经有了两个儿子。

sentences.en: But Cook's new law-abiding image and family man lifestyle didn't put a stop to his criminal activities.
sentences.zh: 但库克新的守法形象和顾家男人的生活方式并没有停止他的犯罪活动。

sentences.en: In 1953, he broke into the home of some fellow church members and stole from them.
sentences.zh: 1953年，他闯入了一些教会成员的家中并偷窃了财物。

sentences.en: His fingerprints led to his arrest and he was placed on a good behaviour bond.
sentences.zh: 他的指纹导致他被捕，并被处以良好行为保证金。

sentences.en: In September 1955, two months after the birth of his second son,
sentences.zh: 1955年9月，在他第二个儿子出生两个月后，

sentences.en: Cook had set his sights on another woman.
sentences.zh: 库克又盯上了另一个女人。

sentences.en: When he found out she was playing in a hockey tournament two hours south of Perth in Bunbury, he stole a car to stalk her there.
sentences.zh: 当他发现她正在珀斯以南两小时车程的班伯里参加曲棍球锦标赛时，他偷了一辆车去那里跟踪她。

sentences.en: Cook rolled the car along the way, suffering a broken sternum plus face and knee injuries.
sentences.zh: 库克在途中翻了车，导致胸骨骨折，脸部和膝盖受伤。

sentences.en: The incident led to him being charged with assuming control of a motor vehicle.
sentences.zh: 这起事件导致他被控擅自驾驶机动车。

sentences.en: Cook was sentenced to two years hard labour for the theft as well as an additional six months for breaking his good behaviour bond.
sentences.zh: 库克因盗窃罪被判处两年苦役，并因违反良好行为保证金被额外判处六个月监禁。

sentences.en: His young wife,
sentences.zh: 他年轻的妻子，

sentences.en: Sally, had to raise their two children alone as a single parent but still made sure to visit Cook in prison.
sentences.zh: 萨莉，不得不独自抚养两个孩子，但仍坚持去监狱探望库克。

sentences.en: She stood by her husband throughout his incarceration.
sentences.zh: 她在丈夫服刑期间一直支持着他。

sentences.en: He was back with his family by Christmas 1956.
sentences.zh: 1956年圣诞节时，他回到了家人身边。

sentences.en: Following Eric Edgar Cook's second release, he appeared to mostly stick to the straight and narrow, focusing on working hard to support his growing family.
sentences.zh: 在埃里克·埃德加·库克第二次获释后，他似乎大多走上了正道，专注于努力工作以养活日益壮大的家庭。

sentences.en: He and Sally would eventually go on to have five more children, giving them a total of seven, four boys and three girls.
sentences.zh: 他和萨莉最终又生了五个孩子，总共有七个，四个男孩和三个女孩。

sentences.en: On Monday, January 25, 1960,
sentences.zh: 1960年1月25日，星期一，

sentences.en: Cook's reputation was tarnished once again when he was arrested for loitering in a park in Lath Lane, one of Perth's inner-eastern suburbs.
sentences.zh: 库克的名声再次受损，因为他在珀斯内东郊之一的拉斯巷的一个公园里游荡而被捕。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to a month's incarceration in Fremantle Prison.
sentences.zh: 他被判在弗里曼特尔监狱服刑一个月。

sentences.en: While there, police questioned him about a horrific murder that had been committed the previous month, the brutal killing of 22-year-old heiress and socialite
sentences.zh: 在那里，警方就上个月发生的一起可怕谋杀案审问了他，那是对22岁女继承人和名媛的残忍杀害，

sentences.en: Gillian Brewer.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安·布鲁尔。

sentences.en: During Cook's break-ins, he was known to steal women's underwear and masturbate with it.
sentences.zh: 在库克的入室盗窃过程中，他有偷窃女性内衣并用其自慰的习惯。

sentences.en: This deviant criminal history led police to label him a, quote, sexo and wonder if he could be behind the young woman's murder.
sentences.zh: 这段变态的犯罪史使警方给他贴上了“性变态”的标签，并怀疑他是否是这名年轻女子谋杀案的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: Cook denied having anything to do with the crime, claiming he was home at the time, and his wife Sally supported this alibi.
sentences.zh: 库克否认与该罪行有任何关系，声称案发时他在家，他的妻子萨莉也证实了这一不在场证明。

sentences.en: After that,
sentences.zh: 在那之后，

sentences.en: Cook was still occasionally cited by the police for peeping Tom and minor theft offences, but they never suspected him of murder.
sentences.zh: 库克偶尔仍会被警方传唤，原因包括偷窥和轻微盗窃，但他们从未怀疑他杀人。

sentences.en: Not until more than three and a half years later, in the early hours of Sunday September 1,
sentences.zh: 直到三年半多以后，即9月1日星期日凌晨，

sentences.en: 1963, when he went to the suburb of Mount Pleasant to collect the rifle used to kill university student
sentences.zh: 1963年，他前往芒特普莱森特郊区，取走了用于杀害大学生

sentences.en: Shirley MacLeod.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·麦克劳德的步枪。
